name: ath
description: The Athenaeum's reference tooling: the ath CLI, the athd host daemon and the residence scanner (spec/athenaeum.md).

scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun test
scripts.build: bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 ./packages/cli/src/main.ts --outfile dist/ath && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 ./packages/scanner/src/cli.ts --outfile dist/ath-scan
scripts.build:arm64: bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-arm64 ./packages/cli/src/main.ts --outfile dist/ath-arm64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-arm64 ./packages/scanner/src/cli.ts --outfile dist/ath-scan-arm64
